name: SentinelAI Telegram Anti-Spam Bot
description: AI-powered Telegram group anti-spam moderation bot with admin training, auto-delete, authorized-chat enforcement, and suspicious-content review.

AI_PROVIDER.description: AI provider to use: openai, openai_compatible, newapi, hcnsec, deepseek, gemini, ollama, mock, or rules_only.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. Required when AI_PROVIDER=openai.

OPENAI_ESCALATION_MODEL.description: Escalation model for uncertain moderation decisions.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible third-party gateways such as hcnsec/NewAPI/OpenRouter/DeepSeek.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible gateway, for example https://api.hcnsec.cn or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible gateway.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_PROVIDER_NAME.description: Name stored in moderation logs for the gateway.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_USE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.description: Set true only if the gateway/model supports OpenAI strict json_schema response_format.

HCNSEC_API_KEY.description: Optional hcnsec/NewAPI key alias. Prefer Heroku config vars; never commit secrets.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Official DeepSeek API key alias when AI_PROVIDER=deepseek.

DATABASE_URL.description: Database URL. Heroku Postgres normally provides this automatically.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis URL. Optional for basic testing.

WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.description: Public Heroku app URL, for example https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Secret path segment used for Telegram webhook security. Use a long random string.

AUTHORIZED_CHAT_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram group/supergroup chat IDs allowed to use this bot.

OWNER_ADMIN_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to authorize chats with /setup.

RETENTION_DAYS.description: Number of days to keep moderation logs.

AI_USE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.description: Use structured JSON output when supported by provider.

AI_ESCALATE_ON_UNSURE.description: Use stronger escalation model for uncertain decisions.

AI_ENABLE_PROVIDER_FALLBACK.description: Fallback to another provider or rules-only mode when primary AI fails.

AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER.description: Fallback provider: gemini, ollama, mock, or rules_only.

AUTO_SET_WEBHOOK.description: Automatically register Telegram webhook on startup.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_MAX_CONNECTIONS.description: Maximum concurrent Telegram webhook deliveries. Lower values prevent outage replay floods.

TELEGRAM_DROP_PENDING_UPDATES_ON_STARTUP.description: Drop stale Telegram updates on startup so old offline group messages are not replayed.

AUTO_MIGRATE.description: Automatically run database setup on startup.

DEMO_MODE.description: Safe demo mode. No bans and no deletes unless explicitly confirmed by admin.

SPAM_REPEAT_BAN_AFTER.description: Ban a user after this many confirmed spam deletions in the same group. Set 0 to disable repeat-spam bans.

MODERATION_DELETE_NOTICE_ENABLED.description: Send a short group notice after Sentinel successfully deletes spam.

MODERATION_NOTICE_CLEANUP_SECONDS.description: Seconds before Sentinel deletes its own spam-cleanup notices. Set 0 to keep notices.
